body.title: Guided demo: one task, end to end
body.intro: This walks the full MVP loop once on the seeded demo repository: meeting → brief → plan → approval → sandboxed execution → human edit → done signal → reviewer → draft PR → human review → manual merge. Nothing here touches a real repo, and every step is visible in the UI.
body.repoHint: Push the demo repo (deploy/scripts/push_demo_to_github.sh) to a scratch GitHub repository, then connect it like any other repo.

steps.title: Discuss the task in the Meeting Area
steps.description: Create a meeting for the demo task. The AI participant stays muted until explicitly invoked — invite it for quick research or a summary, not to fill the channel.

steps.title: Generate and approve the engineering brief
steps.description: Invoke 'turn this into a brief'. Check the five fields — requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria, risks, open questions — then approve. The brief is what the agent plans against, so read it before approving.

steps.title: Review the agent's proposed plan
steps.description: The agent proposes a plan: goal, files likely to change, steps, tests, risks, estimated cost, forbidden paths, expected result. Nothing executes until you approve.

steps.title: Approve the plan
steps.description: Approving is the governance gate: this approval is audit-logged and the sandbox will refuse commands until it exists.

steps.title: Watch execution — terminal, diff, cost
steps.description: The agent works on its own branch in an ephemeral sandbox. Watch live terminal output, the growing diff, test results, and cost metering.

steps.title: Pause and take over with a human edit
steps.description: Start editing a file in the Working Area — the agent pauses the moment you touch the buffer. No timer, no forced handover.

steps.title: Send the explicit done signal
steps.description: Press the Done button (or Cmd+S / Cmd+Enter). Only this signal — never per-keystroke analysis — triggers the reviewer sub-agent.

steps.title: Read the reviewer's verdict
steps.description: The reviewer sub-agent checks syntax, conflicts with existing code, and brief alignment on a cheaper model. Its verdict is visible to the whole team before the agent resumes.

steps.title: Open the draft PR with the AI summary
steps.description: The GitHub service opens a draft PR carrying the AI-written summary: what changed, why, what didn't change, what needs review, what's risky.

steps.title: Review in the Review Area
steps.description: See the diff with high-risk zones highlighted (auth, payments, migrations, secrets). Comment inline; approve or request changes.

steps.title: Merge manually on GitHub
steps.description: The final act is yours: click Merge on GitHub. The app cannot do it for you — by design.
